description: Use this when the user asks which countries EOR Scope covers, or wants the countries of a region (Europe, Asia, Latin America...) with ISO code, currency, an example salary and the statutory employer cost at that salary. Also use it when the user asks in which countries hiring costs the employer the least in statutory charges (e.g. "countries where employer charges are smallest for a 60k hire", "pays où les charges patronales sont les plus faibles"): pass salary_usd and sort_by "statutory_employer_charge" to order the countries by statutory employer charge at equal salary, from the smallest. A country whose total is declared "at least" or "at most" at that salary is listed apart, never ordered among totals. The order covers statutory charges only, before any Employer of Record fee. Do not use for the detailed cost of one country (use employer_cost). Data snapshot 2026-11-06. Cost comparison, not legal or tax advice.

salary_usd.description: Gross annual salary in USD, the same in every country: each country then gets its statutory employer charge at that salary

sort_by.description: "name" (alphabetical, default) or "statutory_employer_charge": statutory employer charge at equal salary, from the smallest; needs salary_usd

name: list_countries
